name: voz
description: Opt-in voice mode: each reply ends with an audio version read by macOS say, summarized by Haiku in Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Spoken summaries of replies, off until you ask.
interface.longDescription: Ask Codex to turn voice mode on. Each reply then ends with an audio version of its plain text, read by macOS say. Audio is stored in ~/.local/share/voz and deleted after 14 days.
defaultPrompt: Use voz to turn voice mode on.
Use voz to turn voice mode off.
